summary: High Tide Inc., a Nasdaq/TSXV-listed Canadian cannabis retailer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing completion of its acquisition of an established retail cannabis store at 100 Rainbow Road, Chestermere, Alberta. The arm's-length transaction closed October 8, 2026, for C$670,000 cash, representing 2.1x the store's annualized Adjusted EBITDA of roughly C$316,000 for the three months ended August 31, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The store will rebrand as Canna Cabana, lifting High Tide to 234 Canadian locations, 93 in Alberta. Watch integration, rebranding timing, and accretion against the stated disciplined-valuation strategy.
